newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH WOOD PURCHASES LIVELIER IN AUG, SEPT - METLA.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH WOOD PURCHASES LIVELIER IN AUG, SEPT - METLA.

text.p: The Finnish forest industry's wood purchases from private forests increased in August and September, the Finnish Forest Research Insitute (METLA) said in a report on Tuesday.
"The forest industry bought 1.7 million cubic metres of raw wood from private forests in total in August. The amount is 1.0 million cubic metres larger than in July," it said.
"Already in the the first two weeks of September, the forest industry bought 1.4 million cubic metres of raw wood," it said.
